title: Multilinear polynomial on the sign cube
statement: Given real coefficients $a(S)$ indexed by subsets $S$ of the coordinates, the associated multilinear polynomial on the sign cube is $P(x)=\sum_S a(S)\prod_{i\in S}x_i$.
hypotheses_covered: A real coefficient function on subsets of the coordinates
